episodes.summary: Rose uncovers Alan's Ponzi scheme and Alan, in turn, meets "Manny," Rose's mannequin "husband." Meanwhile, Charlie is eager to get some alone time with Rose.

episodes.title: Nice to Meet You, Walden Schmidt
episodes.summary: Ashton Kutcher joins the cast as Walden Schmidt, an internet billionaire with a broken heart.

episodes.title: People Who Love Peepholes
episodes.summary: Judy Greer is introduced as Bridget, Walden's ex-wife.

episodes.title: Big Girls Don't Throw Food
episodes.summary: Alan prepares Walden for a date with Bridget, while Jake decides to emulate Walden and drop out of school.

episodes.title: Nine Magic Fingers
episodes.summary: Trying to rebound from his recent separation, Walden goes looking for Mrs. Right, while Alan has an opportunity to reconcile with Lyndsey.

episodes.title: A Giant Cat Holding a Churro
episodes.summary: Alan struggles to come to terms with Lyndsey's risque movie past, and Walden tries to cheer him up by throwing a party at the house.

episodes.title: The Squat and the Hover
episodes.summary: Walden receives divorce papers from Bridget, but forgets his depression when he meets a girl who looks eerily like her.

episodes.title: Those Fancy Japanese Toilets
episodes.summary: Jake has a crush on his chemistry tutor, who has a crush on Walden. Meanwhile, Alan obsesses over the journal his brother left him in his will.

episodes.title: Thank You for the Intercourse
episodes.summary: When Walden begins redecorating the beach house, Alan becomes overly emotional.

episodes.title: Frodo's Headshots
episodes.summary: Upon his release from the hospital, Alan is met with a slew of challenges that test his ability to cope.

episodes.title: A Fishbowl Full of Glass Eyes
episodes.summary: Walden hits it off with a British babe, but neither of them is sure he's ready to re-enter the dating world.

episodes.title: What a Lovely Landing Strip
episodes.summary: Walden is trying his best to impress his new love interest when Bridget reappears in his life.

episodes.title: One False Move, Zimbabwe!
episodes.summary: Walden's mother arrives and Alan is smitten with her, even as she reveals a secret about Walden's past that sends him into a downward spiral.

episodes.title: Slowly and in a Circular Fashion
episodes.summary: When Walden's ex-wife and his mother try to take control of his company, he tries to enlist Alan as an ally.

episodes.title: A Possum on Chemo
episodes.summary: Zoey tries to coerce Walden into cutting his hair and shaving. Meanwhile, Alan and Lyndsey rekindle their relationship.

episodes.title: The Duchess of Dull-in-Sack
episodes.summary: Walden tries to loosen up Zoey by sharing a couple of Berta's special brownies.

episodes.title: Sips, Sonnets and Sodomy
episodes.summary: Strained relationships and girl-fighting result when a huge storm traps Walden, Alan, Zoey and Lyndsey in the house on Valentine's Day.

episodes.title: Not in My Mouth!
episodes.summary: Walden and Zoey's relationship suffers after they share a near-death experience. Meanwhile, Alan wonders if Lyndsey has a drinking problem.

episodes.title: The War Against Gingivitis
episodes.summary: Things get tense in the Malibu house when Walden's estranged ex-business partner shows up looking to bury the hatchet.

episodes.title: Palmdale, Ech
episodes.summary: Alan and Lyndsey introduce their mothers to one another. Meanwhile, Jake and Eldridge enlist Walden to drive them to a high school party.

episodes.title: Grandma's Pie
episodes.summary: Walden breaks the news to Zoey that he is going into business with his ex-wife. Meanwhile, Alan and Lyndsey try to come to terms with their moms' new relationship.

episodes.title: Mr. Hose Says 'Yes'
episodes.summary: Walden's commitment is tested when Zoey and her daughter come to live with him. Meanwhile, Alan gets more than he bargained for when he moves in with Lyndsey.

episodes.title: Why We Gave Up Women
episodes.summary: After Alan suffers a minor heart attack, Charlie's ghost pays a visit to his hospital bedside.

episodes.title: The Straw in My Donut Hole
episodes.summary: Alan is showered with love and affection upon returning from the hospital, but Zoey isn't so sure it's deserved.

episodes.title: Oh Look! Al-Qaeda!
episodes.summary: Jake is pressured to make a decision about his future.

episodes.title: I Changed My Mind About the Milk
episodes.summary: Walden plans a big surprise for Zoey's birthday.

episodes.title: A Big Bag of Dog
episodes.summary: Following his break-up with Zoey, Walden has a breakdown.

episodes.title: Four Balls, Two Bats and One Mitt
episodes.summary: Alan and Lyndsey decide to spice things up in the bedroom.

episodes.title: You Do Know What the Lollipop's For
episodes.summary: Walden starts to feel his age when a friend's daughter comes to town.

episodes.title: That's Not What They Call It in Amsterdam
episodes.summary: Despite Alan's warnings, Walden starts dating Rose.

episodes.title: Ferrets, Attack!
episodes.summary: Walden has to choose between Rose and Zoey.

episodes.title: Avoid the Chinese Mustard
episodes.summary: Tired of the complications of a traditional relationship, Walden hires an actress to play the part of his girlfriend. Meanwhile, Jake and Missi plan a rendezvous at the beach house.

episodes.title: Something My Gynecologist Said
episodes.summary: Alan is hesitant to make a serious commitment to Lyndsey but gets inspiration from an unlikely source. Meanwhile, Walden enjoys being a boy-toy for a rich older woman.

episodes.title: I Scream When I Pee
episodes.summary: Alan's smokin' hot, famous ex-wife, Kandi, wants him back. Meanwhile, Berta isn't interested in celebrating her birthday, so Walden helps make it special.

episodes.title: One Nut Johnson
episodes.summary: Alan helps Walden create a new identity in order to find a woman who isn't just after his money.

episodes.title: Give Santa a Tail-Hole
episodes.summary: Walden juggles having two identities - rich man and poor man - and Alan finds himself alone at Christmas.

episodes.title: Welcome to Alancrest
episodes.summary: Using Walden's money, Alan invests in Kate's fashion line. Meanwhile, leading a double life starts to take its toll on Walden.

episodes.title: Grab a Feather and Get in Line
episodes.summary: Walden and Alan go to Kate's fashion show in New York so Walden can tell her the truth about his identity.

episodes.title: Run, Steven Staven! Run!
episodes.summary: Alan and Lyndsey's relationship is strained when he won't give her a key to the beach house. Meanwhile, Walden, Alan, Billy and Herb commiserate about women and relationships.

episodes.title: Paint It, Pierce It or Plug It
episodes.summary: Alan has concerns when Jake brings his 36-year-old girlfriend home for a visit. Meanwhile, Walden tries to keep a secret from Alan.

episodes.title: Advantage: Fat, Flying Baby
episodes.summary: Walden, depressed about being single on Valentine's Day, tries to convince Kate to give him another chance. Meanwhile, Alan's Valentine's Day plans take a turn for the worse.

episodes.title: Throgwarten Middle School Mysteries
episodes.summary: When Walden runs into his ex-wife at a high-end singles mixer and they talk about getting back together, Alan worries that she's not good for Walden.

episodes.title: The 9:04 from Pemberton
episodes.summary: Following a fight with Walden, Alan moves in with Herb.

episodes.title: Big Episode. Someone Stole a Spoon
episodes.summary: Walden and Alan try to cheer up a lonely Herb, but end up partying a little too hard.

episodes.title: Bazinga! That's from a TV Show
episodes.summary: When Jake cheats on his girlfriend with her 18-year-old daughter, Alan and Walden get caught in the crossfire.

episodes.title: Another Night with Neil Diamond
episodes.summary: Alan has trouble coping when Lyndsey dumps him and Walden must find a way to help him get back on his feet.

episodes.title: My Bodacious Vidalia
episodes.summary: When Walden encourages a depressed Alan to update his look and start dating again, Alan faces a moral dilemma when he attracts a married woman.

episodes.title: Cows, Prepare to Be Tipped
episodes.summary: Walden dates a hot 22-year-old woman, but finds himself more attracted to her worldly grandmother. Meanwhile, Alan and Jake go on a father-son bonding trip.

episodes.title: Nangnangnangnang
episodes.summary: Alan is shocked when Charlie's 25-year-old daughter shows up at Walden's beach house to connect with what's left of her family, and who happens to like everything her dad liked - including women.

episodes.title: I Think I Banged Lucille Ball
episodes.summary: When Walden feels cramped in his own house, Jenny moves in with Evelyn and her boyfriend, Marty. Meanwhile, Alan becomes Lyndsey's "other man".

episodes.title: This Unblessed Biscuit
episodes.summary: Walden and Alan think it may be time for Berta to retire when she injures her back at work.

episodes.title: Clank, Clank, Drunken Skank
episodes.summary: Walden starts partying with Jenny and her hot friends. Meanwhile, Alan and Lyndsey's illicit affair is jeopardized.

episodes.title: Alan Harper, Pleasing Women Since 2003
episodes.summary: Alan befriends Lyndsey's boyfriend in an effort to find out what he has that Alan doesn't. Meanwhile, Walden helps Jenny be more proactive in pursuing her acting career.

episodes.title: Justice in Star-Spangled Hot Pants
episodes.summary: When Alan learns Walden knows Lynda Carter, he asks him to set him up on a date with her. Against his better judgment, Walden agrees to invite her to the house for dinner.

episodes.title: Some Kind of Lesbian Zombie
episodes.summary: Walden and Alan find themselves on dates with two ideal women until Lyndsey's jealousy throws a wrench in their evening.

episodes.title: Mr. Walden, He Die. I Clean Room.
episodes.summary: Alan and Lyndsey's illicit affair puts Walden in danger, forcing him to accept Rose's help.

episodes.title: Numero Uno Accidente Lawyer
episodes.summary: Walden's date with an accident-prone model goes longer than expected. Meanwhile, Alan dates a woman who shares some surprising personal information with him.

episodes.title: On Vodka, on Soda, on Blender, on Mixer!
episodes.summary: Walden helps Jenny get a second date with a one-night stand and Alan's transgender girlfriend's ex-wife hits on him. Meanwhile, in the spirit of the holidays, Alan receives a Japanese delicacy from Jake for Christmas, and Walden's Malibu house is alive with questionable Christmas carol lyrics.

episodes.title: Tazed in the Lady Nuts
episodes.summary: Walden joins his beautiful former employee on a brilliant new project. Meanwhile, Alan advises Jenny to open up to her girlfriend or risk losing her.

episodes.title: Baseball. Boobs. Boobs. Baseball.
episodes.summary: Alan lets Lyndsey's boyfriend Larry set him up on a date. Meanwhile, Walden offers to help Nicole with her software project so she'll have time to date him.

episodes.title: Bite Me, Supreme Court
episodes.summary: After Marty proposes to Evelyn, Walden and Alan throw him a bachelor party with several of his old friends.

episodes.title: Three Fingers of Crème de Menthe
episodes.summary: Alan learns that Lyndsey broke up with Larry and didn't tell him. Meanwhile, Walden sets out to prove that he's a man's man.

episodes.title: Cab Fare and a Bottle of Penicillin
episodes.summary: Alan gives Lyndsey the option of choosing between him and Larry. Meanwhile, Jenny fears she and Brooke are growing apart.

episodes.title: How to Get Rid of Alan Harper
episodes.summary: "How To Get Rid of Alan Harper"- Walden suspects his new girlfriend is cheating on him. Meanwhile, Alan gets even more intertwined in Lyndsey and Larry's relationship when he starts dating Larry's sister, Gretchen.

episodes.title: Welcome Home, Jake
episodes.summary: Lyndsey discovers that Alan is sleeping with Larry's sister, Gretchen. Meanwhile, Walden struggles with telling Barry to find his own place.

episodes.title: West Side Story
episodes.summary: Walden gets an invitation to his ex-girlfriend's boutique opening. Meanwhile, Gretchen wants to spend more time at Alan's house.

episodes.title: Lan Mao Shi Zai Wuding Shang
episodes.summary: Walden reconnects with Kate and is sure she's "The One" - that is, until he meets Vivian and becomes convinced she's "The One." Meanwhile, Alan and Gretchen grow closer.

episodes.title: Lotta Delis in Little Armenia
episodes.summary: Alan stumbles upon an opportunity to make money. Meanwhile, Walden has to address his co-dependency issues.

episodes.title: Dial 1-900-Mix-a-Lot
episodes.summary: Alan's girlfriend, Gretchen, insists he confess his true identity to Larry. Meanwhile, Walden goes on a road trip with Jenny and Barry to see his first car.

episodes.title: Oh WALD-E, Good Times Ahead
episodes.summary: Alan confesses his true identity to Larry and has to face the consequences.

episodes.title: The Ol' Mexican Spinach
episodes.summary: Following a health scare on Halloween, Walden decides to reprioritize his life with Alan's help.

episodes.title: A Chic Bar in Ibiza
episodes.summary: When Walden asks Alan to sign a pre-nup, Alan gets offended and has second thoughts about getting married.

episodes.title: Glamping in a Yurt
episodes.summary: Alan and Walden have a meeting with an adoption social worker that hinges on them being convincing as a loving couple. Meanwhile, Lyndsey returns after 60 days in rehab.

episodes.title: Thirty-Eight, Sixty-Two, Thirty-Eight
episodes.summary: Walden and Alan meet a birth mother who's considering them to adopt her baby.

episodes.title: Oontz. Oontz. Oontz.
episodes.summary: Walden decides to foster a 6-year-old boy, but begins to doubt himself when they don't bond like he expected.

episodes.title: Alan Shot a Little Girl
episodes.summary: When Alan realizes Louis thinks he's cool, he starts breaking Walden's rules in order to stay that way.

episodes.title: Sex with an Animated Ed Asner
episodes.summary: Alan and Walden befriend three moms at a kids' gym, but things get complicated when Walden becomes attracted to one of them. Meanwhile, Alan goes out for a girls' night with a group of moms.

episodes.title: Family, Bublé, Deep-fried Turkey
episodes.summary: Walden and Alan are determined to convince Louis that Santa Claus is real.

episodes.title: Bouncy, Bouncy, Bouncy, Lyndsey
episodes.summary: Walden discovers how challenging it is to be intimate with women when his foster son, Louis, is in the house. Also, Herb asks Alan if he can go on a date with Lyndsey.

episodes.title: Here I Come, Pants!
episodes.summary: Alan takes it upon himself to help Walden keep Louis after the social worker discovers he and Walden are not really a gay couple.

episodes.title: For Whom the Booty Calls
episodes.summary: Walden joins a group for adoptive fathers, and finds it to be a nice escape from Alan.

episodes.title: A Beer-Battered Rip-Off
episodes.summary: When Alan breaks up with their social worker to get back together with Lyndsey, Walden worries it will affect Louis' adoption.

episodes.title: Boompa Loved His Hookers
episodes.summary: Walden fears if he breaks up with Ms. McMartin, it will jeopardize his adoption of Louis. Also, Alan hesitates when Lyndsey asks him to move in with her.

episodes.title: Don't Give a Monkey a Gun
episodes.summary: After they sign their divorce papers, Walden offers Alan the gift of his choice, but when Alan chooses something selfish and impractical, it puts his relationship with Lyndsey on the line.

episodes.title: Of Course He's Dead - Part One
episodes.summary: Charlie Harper is alive. Or is he?

episodes.title: Of Course He's Dead - Part Two
episodes.summary: The series finale recalls the life—and presumed death—of Charlie Harper.
